geometry_edits.rationale: Transform the dominant mass from a closed bent bar into a split-wing composition that can express an access-facing public void.
Preserve the long-axis reading of the building.
Open a legible void between wings for entrance, terrace, or court logic.
Maintain a clear anchored base so the split mass remains one coherent building.
Strengthen the public threshold at grade.
Retain the calm stepped upper massing after the programmatic opening is added.

graph_edits.rationale: Recast the dominant bar into a split-wing/hinged condition so the mass can open a visible public threshold toward the access edge instead of remaining a sealed stepped block.
Keep the dominant gesture longitudinal and legible while the opening is introduced.
Create a readable split that can become a ground-level entry void or public court.
Preserve continuity while adding a grounded public base rather than a floating sculptural stack.
Give the public ground figure enough thickness to register in all views.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent stepped bar in all four views, and the silhouette is readable and internally consistent, so it does not fail on fragmentation or collision. However, the mass is mostly a sealed, compact stack with no meaningful carved void, entry seam, court, or undercut responding to the verified access edge. The blue access line is treated more as an adjacent condition than a public threshold, which conflicts with the neighborhood-living brief calling for an active ground edge and one clear public void or terrace. The stepped upper profile is acceptable as a section gesture, but here it reads closer to generic tiered massing than a program-supporting occupied section. The form therefore needs a better ground carve and clearer access-facing public figure to become program-fit.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller and more tower-like than the neighborhood-living brief; the candidate should not drift into an office/tower typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped upper massing can read as a coherent capacity-bearing profile when the base remains legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Office-tower language is not directly appropriate for a compact mixed neighborhood building; use only the sectional hierarchy idea.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A strong vertical hierarchy with a controlled setback profile can still preserve a clear dominant mass.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The candidate lacks the clearly articulated active edge and ground/public seam that make this reference work.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A simple ground-attentive commercial mass with an evident entry/canopy threshold supports neighborhood living well.

warnings: Parcel containment appears satisfied in the visible views; the main issue is semantic/programmatic rather than gross boundary violation.
The current step mass is coherent, but the access response is weak and semantically opposite to the required active threshold.
The form risks reading as a small tower/podium fragment rather than a neighborhood mixed-use street building.
